_comment: Which vendor PNGs go into which atlas, under which frame name.
Frame names are OURS, not Kenney's (docs/51 §4). That indirection is the
whole point: swapping art packs is an edit to this file, and skins.json
never learns where a pixel came from.
Paths are relative to assets/vendor/kenney/. A missing source is reported
and skipped — the atlas still builds, and the frame falls back to a

items._note: Frames named for ItemDef.sprite (crates/game-core/src/items/registry.rs), which has been populated since T4.01 and unreadable by the client until item_registry_json() exported it. A missing frame falls back to a tinted box and logs once (docs/50 §8).
